description: This file declares external functions for reading fields and lines from a file, specifically part of the 'tinysrp' module related to SRP (Secure Remote Password) authentication. It contains include guards and function prototypes for t_nextfield and t_nextline, with associated copyright and licensing information.

methods.name: t_nextfield
methods.description: Reads the next field from a file stream into a buffer, returning an integer status code.

methods.name: t_nextline
methods.description: Reads the next line from a file stream.
